title: Can I Modify the Header Panel?

content:
First, I use Header Panel to mean the display panel with some message details just above the message display window, i.e. From:, To:, Message Title:, etc.

There are four lines with lots of empty space. It reduces the amount of message display considerably. I'd be happy with two lines - From: + icon buttons on line one, and To: + Message Title on line 2.
